stem:
Sana has a frequency table that shows how many students chose each club for the hobby fair. She now wants to pair each student with the club that student chose.

What does she need?

options.text: The frequency table alone, because the table is already the list of individual student choices.
Only the frequency table, even though she must match each student to one club.
The individual records, because the frequency table keeps category totals but not which student chose which club.
A decorated chart title, because neat artwork is what makes the pairing possible.

teacher.key_rationale: Category totals do not name which student chose which club. Pairing needs the individual records.
